notes: NvidiaToken (src/NvidiaToken.sol) is a fixed-supply ERC-20 built on OpenZeppelin v5 ERC20 with a transfer tax. The constructor takes the launch factory ($factory), the Uniswap v4 PoolManager ($poolManager) and this launch's number ($launchNumber, uint64), reverts if either address is zero, and mints the whole supply of 1,000,000,000 ADVN (1000000000000000000000000000 minor units, 18 decimals) once to msg.sender, the factory. Nothing can mint afterwards. There is no owner, pauser, blacklist, fee setter, minter or upgrade path. Every ordinary transfer is split three ways in _update: 0.5% (TRIBUTE_BPS = 50) goes to Jensen Huang's wallet 0xc59b0c072f73ceea3dc354031165501c0ff25023 (a constant), 1% (BURN_BPS = 100) is burned from totalSupply, and the receiver gets the remaining 98.5%; each cut rounds down. Launch flows move exactly what they say: transfers from or to the factory, from or to the PoolManager, and from or to the launch's MerkleDistributor (read from the factory with distributorOf(launchNumber) at transfer time via staticcall, then cached) are untaxed, so the swarm's share, claims, the pool seed and every swap through the PoolManager settle exactly. Mints and burns are also exact. Trades in the launch's v4 pool are therefore untaxed; wallet-to-wallet transfers and transfers to other venues pay the tax. The constructor makes no external call. No application contracts are deployed and no initialization calls are made. The token's runtime contains no DELEGATECALL, CALLCODE or SELFDESTRUCT.
